stances.desc:
Courtly Vassals believe in nobility and tradition, and wish to preserve existing hierarchies. Social or compassionate Vassals often adopt this Vassal Stance.

Courtly Vassals like when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETGives them Court Positions
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETCreates new Titles
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETInvites them to Feast Activities

Courtly Vassals dislike when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETGives Titles to Lowborn characters
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETMarries a Lowborn character as Primary Spouse
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETDisinherits non-disputed Heirs

They prefer social and compassionate Heirs with a high Diplomacy skill.
stances.name: Courtly

stances.desc:
Glory Hound Vassals care about standing and prestige, and showing the world the strength of the realm they're part of. Bold or discompassionate Vassals often adopt this Vassal Stance.

Glory Hound Vassals like when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETHas any Partition Succession Law
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETAchieves Victory in offensive Wars
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETInvites them to Hunt Activities

Glory Hound Vassals dislike when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETHas high Crown Authority
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETSigns Defeat or White Peace in Wars
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETMarries a Lowborn character as Primary Spouse

They prefer bold and brave Heirs with a high Martial skill.
stances.name: Glory Hound

stances.desc:
Minor Landholder Vassals wish for freedom and low taxes. All Baron-tier Rulers will adopt this Vassal Stance.

Minor Landholder Vassals like when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETHas low Crown Authority

Minor Landholder Vassals dislike when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETRevokes Baronies
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETHas high Crown Authority

They prefer generous and compassionate Heirs.
stances.name: Minor Landholder

stances.desc:
Minority Vassals feel that their Faith or Culture is marginalized by their Liege. Vassals of Hostile Faiths or Cultures with less than 30% Cultural Acceptance often adopt this Vassal Stance.

Minority Vassals like when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETUses the Promote Cultural Acceptance Councillor Task
(as they will often change stance when above 30% Cultural Acceptance)

Minority Vassals dislike when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETConverts the Faith or Culture of a County
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETHas high Crown Authority

They prefer honorable and compassionate Heirs, preferably of another faith or culture than their current Liege.
stances.name: Minority

stances.desc:
Parochial Vassals want stability, decentralization, and peace, and for the realm to stay out of outside affairs. Honorable or reserved Vassals often adopt this Vassal Stance.

Parochial Vassals like when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETConstructs or upgrades Holdings
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETMakes them Guardians of Close Family
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETUses the Domestic Affairs Councillor Task

Parochial Vassals dislike when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETHas high Crown Authority
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETDeclares non-trivial Wars

They prefer honorable and rational Heirs with a high Stewardship skill.
stances.name: Parochial

stances.desc:
Zealot Vassals are focused on matters of the faith, and are swayed by pious actions. Zealous or vengeful Vassals often adopt this Vassal Stance, as do Clergy.

Zealot Vassals like when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETConstructs or upgrades Temple Holdings
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETSucceeds with the Learn Language Scheme
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETHas Virtuous Traits
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETGoes on Pilgrimage Activities

Zealot Vassals dislike when their Liege:
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETAsks the Head of Faith for Gold
EFFECT_LIST_BULLETHas Sinful Traits

They prefer zealous and virtuous Heirs with a high Learning skill.
stances.name: Zealot
